Visit note | 2025-01-28 03:00 PM | Dr. Rezaul Karim, Neurology | Patient: Masud Howlader, 37, male. This patient presents with recurrent headaches, complaining that bright light hurts his eyes, he experiences nausea, and he frequently needs to lie down in a dark room to get relief. He works as a bus driver and reports that the symptoms have become worse since facing bright screens at a new job in Jatrabari. He has a history of Bronchial asthma, but denies any recent respiratory distress. On examination, he reports about 6 headache days a month. Other vitals: BP 129/73 mmHg, pulse 91 bpm, weight 57 kg. Neurological examination is normal. Assessment: Migraine. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to keep a headache diary, sleep and eat at regular times, and limit screen time. Follow-up in 3 months with the headache diary.

Visit note | 2025-01-28 03:30 PM | Dr. Shahadat Hossain, ENT | Patient: Karim Sheikh, 45, male. The patient presents with discomfort in his face, describing pressure over the cheeks and forehead, a blocked nose, and thick nasal discharge for over ten days. He works as a hotel receptionist and notes that these symptoms started after a dusty journey to Khulna. He has a comorbidity of Hypothyroidism and is on regular thyroid replacement. On examination: temperature 99.7°F, BP 115/71 mmHg, pulse 98 bpm, weight 74 kg. Tenderness is noted on palpation of the maxillary and frontal sinuses, and nasal mucosa is congested. Assessment: Acute sinusitis. Plan: a prescription was issued. He is advised to use steam inhalation twice daily and drink warm fluids. Follow-up in 10 days.

Visit note | 2025-01-28 03:30 PM | Dr. Towhid Alam, ENT | Patient: Khadija Shikder, 32, female. The patient presents with ear discomfort, reporting muffled hearing, mild fever, and ear pain. She works as a hotel receptionist and mentions that these symptoms started after swimming in a pond in Badda. She has no other comorbidities. On examination: temperature 100.2°F, BP 111/73 mmHg, pulse 103 bpm, weight 48 kg. Otoscopic examination shows a congested, bulging tympanic membrane with loss of light reflex on the affected side. Assessment: Acute otitis media. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to keep the ear dry and do not insert cotton buds. Follow-up in 1 week.

Visit note | 2025-01-28 04:00 PM | Dr. Faisal Karim, Psychiatry | Patient: Khadija Dewan, 49, female. The patient reports significant sleep disturbances, complaining of waking up tired and having trouble falling asleep most nights. She is a lawyer and mentions that this issue started after a noisy construction site opened near her home in Mymensingh. She has no other medical comorbidities. On examination: Insomnia Severity Index score 22, BP 119/79 mmHg, pulse 86 bpm, weight 58 kg. She appears fatigued but is cooperative and oriented. Assessment: Chronic insomnia. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to keep fixed sleep and wake times, avoid screens for an hour before bed, and avoid tea after 4 PM. Follow-up in 4 weeks with a sleep diary.

Visit note | 2025-01-28 04:30 PM | Dr. Asif Mahmud, Dermatology | Patient: Emon Molla, 38, male. The patient presents with skin irritation, complaining of itchy dry patches on the elbows and knees, with symptoms being significantly worse in winter. He works as a journalist and notes that the condition flared during the dry winter in Shyamoli. There are no known comorbidities. On examination, the affected area is about 8 cm across. Other vitals: BP 124/86 mmHg, pulse 72 bpm, weight 68 kg. There are erythematous, dry, and slightly lichenified plaques on the extensor surfaces of both elbows and knees. Assessment: Atopic eczema. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to use a mild soap, avoid hot baths, and wear cotton clothes. Follow-up in 2 weeks.

Visit note | 2025-01-29 09:00 AM | Dr. Nasrin Sultana, Gastroenterology | Patient: Dalia Talukder, 54, female. She was advised to eat smaller meals, avoid oily and spicy food late at night, and raise the head of the bed. Follow-up in 1 month.

Visit note | 2025-01-29 09:30 AM | Dr. Mostafizur Rahman, Orthopedics | Patient: Shathi Mondal, 63, female.
